name: How long does mobile home trim and door repair usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does mobile home trim and door repair usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mobile home door and trim repairs typically take between a few hours to two full days depending on the project scope. Replacing interior door hardware, adjusting hinges, or refitting loose casing can often be completed in an afternoon. In contrast, replacing full pre-hung exterior units or rebuilding rotted wood subflooring and framing around a leaky door frame takes longer. Lead contractor Abraham Becerra directly evaluates the structural condition around the opening, because hidden water damage or shifting walls require carpentry repairs before new doors and trim can be painted and finished.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most simple door or trim repairs take a few hours to a day, while full door replacements involving framing or floor repairs can take one to two days.
